༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad bsdus pa bzhugs so//

na mo ma hā sarba dzñā dar+sha dharmā ka rā ya/ de la jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad nyung ngu zhig bri ba la/ klad kyi don dang gzhung gi don gnyis las/ dang po ni sgrub thabs 'di'i rtsa ba ni bod rnams kyis las kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs mdo 'di yin par 'dod kyang sgrol mar yab gyen brdzes kyi rgyud las 'di'i lha sngags dag gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir jo bo chen pos kyang rgyud 'di pa brten nas mdzad pa yin par mngon no// rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral bar 'dod pa'ang rnam par 'khyams pa ste rgyud de'i thun mong min pa'i sger chos phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs sogs rdor dbyings kyi cho ga'i chings rnams ma bshad pa'i phyir ro// rigs lnga dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung yod pas so snyam na'ang*/ sa paṇa gyis/ spyod pa'i rgyud la rigs lnga yi// don grub na yang tha snyad med// ces rigs lnga'i tha snyad mi mdzad kyang don rigs lnga yod par gsungs pa ltar ro// kha cig gis bya rgyud bdag bskyed can gyi khungs su 'dren mod bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med pa ni ye shes rdo rje kun btus kyi rgyud sogs dang*/ rgya gar ba thams cad dgongs pa mthun/ lha drug gi rnam bzhag kyang mdun du lha bskyed pa la'ang sbyor chog mod/ lha drug gi rnam bzhag bshad pa'i bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud 'di ni bya spyod thun mong gi rgyud yin cing*/ sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad par grags pa'i rnam 'joms 'grel pa de yang mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom/ stong pa yi ge sgra gzugs dang*/ zhes pa'i rgya dper byas na yi ge brgyad pa la kha sgo'i sdeb sbyor kyang tshig rkang gnyis la 'grigs dka' bar snang zhing jo nang kun snying gis bod snga ma'i zin bris bzang po zhig tu snang zhing*/ lha drug gi rnam bzhag ni spyod rgyud kyi lugs bzang ma yin cing*/

bya rgyud la'ang mdun bskyed kyi dbang du gsungs pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// bu ston rin po che'i rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub dkyil ni tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'pho ba'i lugs yin gyi gzhung 'di la brten pa ma yin pas de dang nor bar mi bya'o// rtsa ba bya rgyud rdo rje'i rigs su 'dod nas rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa zer ba rnams ni/ rtsa bar/ gshegs rigs kyi dam rgya bcas la/ oṃ ta thā ga tod+bha ba zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi/ na mo bha ga ba te ak+ṣo bh+yā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ zhes pa gsungs kyi/ badz+ra a k+ṣo bh+ya zhes dang*/ rdor rigs kyi dam rgya bcas nas/ oṃ badz+ro bha ba/ zhes ma gsungs pa 'di gzigs sam/ cha lugs kyang sprul sku yin pa ni/ spyir dam tshig gsum bkod sogs bya rgyud gshegs rigs thams cad chags bral gyi rnam pa can yin pa dang*/ snar thang brgya rtsa nas kyang gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bya rgyud rang rkang du 'dod pa rnams kyang ches mi rigs te/ sngar bshad pa'i ye shes rdo rje kun btus sogs dang jo bo'i gzhung dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// de bas na rang lugs ni bya rgyud spyod rgyud du bkral ba yin par bdag gi bla mas bzhed cing jo nang kun snying sogs kyis kyang de ltar bzhed do// gnyis pa gzhung don la sbyor dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ sgrub po dam tshig ldan pa yis// dgon pa'am grong mtha' la sogs par// khrus byas gtsang mar byas pa yi// las byas bde ba'i stan la 'khod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ khrus chog sogs rgyas par bya rgyud rang rkang ltar byas na legs mod/ mdor bsdu na khrus chu dang bsang gtor byin rlabs tsam byas kyang 'thus pas khro bo bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi phyag rgya bcings la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/

ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang chu sngags te khrus dang*/ oṃ kī li kī li badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun bzlas pas bsang gtor bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la tshogs zhing dang dngos gnyis las dang po/ gzhung las/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka ru// pad+ma zla ba'i steng du hūm̐// de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis// bla ma dang ni mi bskyod pa// spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la// bdun po rnam par dag pa bya// tshad med bzhi dang ldan par ni// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i cho ga ltar gyi tshogs zhing de shin tu gsal ba las/ hūm̐ yig ni sngon po dang 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas dbu brgyan pa'i mi 'khrugs pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa dang*/ rang tha mal ba grangs med pa spros pas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ thugs ka'i sa bon las spros pa'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad 'dzin pa'i lha mo dang*/ rin chen sna bdun sogs kyis mchod/ tshogs rten gshegs shing sems can bde ldan sogs tshad med bzhi sgom pa rnams ni bsod nams tshogs bsags so// de nas mtshan bcas kyi ting 'dzin dngos ni/ gzhung las/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ sems kyis bsgom par byas nas ni// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam// rang gi sa bon de dbus su// de nas rang gi sa bon dang*// phyag mtshan phyag rgyas de byin brlab// zhes lha drug gi rnam bzhag bstan pa ste/ de yang chos rnams thams cad dngos med brjod bral du bzhag pa stong pa'i lha ste ye shes tshogs bsags kyang yin no// de'i ngang las a las zla bar rang gi lha'i sa bon hūm̐ sngon po bsgom pa ni yi ge'i lha/ gshegs rigs kyi dam rgya bcas nas sa bon de rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa bsgom pa ni phyag rgya'i lha/ hūm̐ de la sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa sgra'i lha de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros nas don gnyis byas par rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa thams cad mi 'khrugs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs nas rdo rje hūm̐ la thim par bsam/

dkyil chog tu rang lha'i sa bon yi ge hūm̐/ sngon po 'od zer 'bar bar bsam/ de las 'od 'phros sems can khams sogs nas/ sa bon dang ni phyag rgyar thim// zhes pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje sngon po de'o// de dag yongs su sogs ni/ gzhung las/ de rnams gyur pas mi 'khrugs pa// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo// g.yon pa pang bzhag rdo rje dang*// g.yas pa sa non tshul can bsgom// zhes pa ltar bsgom pa ni gzugs kyi lha dang de'i thugs kar pad zla la hūm̐ yig bsam pa ni mtshan ma'i lha'o// de yang sngar bshad pa ltar rang lugs ni chags bral sprul sku'i cha lugs can no// de dag kyang rgyud las/ dang por khrus byas rnal 'byor bas// rdo rje'i gdan la 'dug nas ni// mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom// stong pa yi ge sgra gzugs dang*// phyag rgya mtshan ma drug tu 'dod// ces 'byung ba ltar ro// hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sku la sogs dbang lha spyan drangs nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang gnas gsum du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa ni/ gzhung las/ ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// zhes pa'i don no// de yang dbang gi skabs tshig gis ma gsal yang rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi dbang tsam yid kyis blang dgos so// de nas/ rang nyid lhar gsal bsgom la ni/ mi 'khrugs mdun nam spyi bor bsgom// rang lus mi 'khrugs bsgom la bstim// zhes pa'i don sgrub thabs 'dir slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis sogs gsungs ltar ye shes pa spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod nas rang la bstim/ 'dir ye shes pa la mchod pa 'bul bar mdzad pa ni rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis kyi spyi 'bre yin pas lags so// gzhung las/ thugs ka pad zlar hūm̐ las ni// dbus su mi bskyod pa nyid bsgom/

phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas bzhi bsgom bya// zhes pa'i don 'dir thugs ka'i pad zla'i hūm̐ sogs ltar thugs kar mi 'khrugs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga gzhung ltar du bsgom/ sgrub byed bshad bzhin sprul sku'i rnam pa nyid yin pa'i gtso bo'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar pad zla la ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po la bzla bya'i sngags kyis g.yas su bskor bar bsam/ de nas gzhung las mchod dang bzlas pa bstod pa bya/ zhes pa'i don sgrub thabs su/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ sogs gong ltar rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rang nyid la mchod par bsam la mchod pa dang*/ gser 'od nas 'byung ba'i rgyal ba zla ba sogs kyis bstod/ gzhan yang rgya gzhung nas 'byung ba'i/ chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes gtan du mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'i bstod pa spro na sbyor/ bzla bya'i sngags kyang ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud las gsungs pa 'di bor nas las sgrib sbyong ba'i sngags thung de bzla ba'ang*/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ni ma yin no// gzhung las/ yan lag bzhi dang dmigs pa gsum// zhes pa'i don gyi yan lag bzhi ni bsam gtan phyi ma las/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol// gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhi la gnas// yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags bzlas// zhes dang rnam snang mngon byang las/ yi ge dang ni yi ge sbyar// de bzhin gzhi dang gzhir 'gyur nyid// ces gsungs pa'i don dkyil chog tu gzhi ni sangs rgyas thugs ka ru sogs nas me long nang gi gzugs bzhin gsal zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa ltar gzhi dang po ni rang lha yi nga rgyal du byed pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal chos dbyings rdo rje'i bar gdam pa rang gi sems bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po gdod ma'i sangs rgyas dang*/

gzhi gnyis pa ni rang nyid gzugs kyi skur bsgom pa dang*/ yi ge dang po ni byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i gzugs su gnas pa dang*/ yi ge gnyis pa ni hūm̐ yig dang sngags phreng ngo*// de don rnams yin pas nges pa'ang ji skad du/ gzhi ni rang gi lha bzhag pa// rang gi lus kyi gnas la bya// gzhi gnyis pa ni rdzogs sangs rgyas// rkang gnyis mchog tu shes par bya// zhes dang*/ yi ge byang chub sems yin te// gnyis pa sgra zhes bya ba yin// bzlas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam dag pa// sngags pas de la gnas par bsam// yi ge rnams ni go rim bzhin// de yi dbus su legs par bkod// zhes pa'i gzhi gnyis gcig dang*/ yi ge dang sems zhes pa don gcig ste yi ge gnyis gcig tu rtsi zhing*/ de la sngags kyi sgra grags pa ni sgra ste/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi gsum mo// de ltar srol rtsol bsdams nas mi g.yo ba bsam gtan bsgrub bzhin par/ ngag dang shub bu dang yid bzlas rdor bzlas rnams bya dgos te/ bsam gtan phyi mar/ gsang sngags bsam gtan zhes bya bar// mchog tu gsang ba yang dag gsungs// drang srong dka' thub chen po dag /de dag med na mi 'grub bo// zhes dang*/ yang*/ dngos grub bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ ngag dang shub bu rdo rje'i bzlas// yid bzlas brjod pa bcas pa bzhi// zhes gsungs so// yang*/ dmigs pa gsum ni ji skad du/ me dang sgra dang sgra mthar gsum// brjod pa me gnas bsam gtan ste// zhes dang*/ me gnas bsam gtan ster ba te// zhes pa spyod rgyud kyi mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin ni bod dag gis bya rgyud la sbyar ba'i dang po mi gnas kyi bsam gtan ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i me'i dbus su sngags kyi yi ge rnams bsam pa la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ gnyis pa sgra gnas kyi bsam gtan ni/ yig 'bru la sems mi 'dzin par sngags kyi sgra dril bu'i sgra lta bu la sems 'dzin pa dang*/

gsum pa sgra mthar gyi bsam btan ni/ de dag thams cad kyi de kho na nyid la sems pa med pa'i tshul gyis ma yengs par bzhag pa'o// gzhan don rang don bzlas pa ni// grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma'o// zhes pa ltar gyi grangs sogs kyi bsnyen pa dang thun mtshams kyi bya ba sogs spyod rgyud spyi ltar ro// de nas mdun bskyed rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs so sor gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ kha cig gis bya rgyud la bum pa gzhal yas khang du bsgom dgos pa'i lung du/ jo bo chen po'i mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil chog las bum pa gzhal yas khang du bsgom par bshad do zhes smra ba ni khungs med/ nged kyis 'di bya rgyud rang rkang du mi 'dod do// mdun bum so sor sa bon sogs lha drug gis gtso bo bskyed/ mdun bum so sor 'khor gyi bkra shis mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad ni/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs zhes pa'i rjes su bkra shis mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad/ sku mdog dkar mo dpal be'u bsnams// me yi phyogs su 'jigs byed ma// sku mdog dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin// gshin rje'i phyogs su 'od can ma// sku mdog dmar skya pad+ma 'dzin// bden bral phyogs su rnam rgyal ma// sku mdog sngon mo rgyal mtshan 'dzin// klu yi phyogs su mdangs ldan ma// sku mdog dmar skya gdugs dkar 'dzin// rlung gi phyogs su dkar shams ma// sku mdog sngon mo yang 'dug dmar skya bum pa 'dzin// gnod sbyin phyogs su dri med ma// sngo skya yang zer sku mdog ljang gu dung 'dzin pa'o// dbang ldan phyogs su yid gzhung ma// sku mdog ljang gu nya bsnam pa'o// kun kyang sems dpa'i skyil krung du// zla ba'i rgyab brten rin chen brgyan// g.yon pa thams cad dku la gtad// de nas mdun bskyed skabs sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab ces pa'i rjes su ye shes spyan 'dren gyi skabs/

dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// bdag gi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang*// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces gzhung las gsungs pa'i cho ga 'dis spyan drangs zhing mchod yon sbrengs par spron bya'o// gzhung snga ma las/ mi 'khrugs rgyal po spyan drangs nas// bgegs bskrad rgyas btab mchod yon sogs// phul te dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug /ces dang gzhung phyi ma las/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ga tod+bha bā ya swā hā/ thal sbyar so sor gnyis phyir bskyed zhes sogs kyang 'byung ngo*// de dag kyang spro na bya zhing ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon ni mi 'byung ngo*// bum bskyed kyi skabs/ khrus kyi don du bum nang lha// mchod bstod byas te nam mkhar bzhugs// de yis dbang bskur bsam la bkru// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ ma ga la shrī batrā ya swā hā/ oṃ maṅga la pad+ma= oṃ maṅga ts+tshat+t+raṃ= oṃ maṅga la shaṃ kha= oṃ maṅga la tsakra= oṃ maṅga la dha dza= oṃ maṅga la kubha= oṃ maṅga la mats+tsha= de yi snying ga'i zla ba la// gsang sngags bzlas te ci nus bzlas/ zhes pa rnams 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i cho gas mdun bskyed dang bum pa dang brabs rdzas dang gzungs kyi yi ge sogs bsgrub par bya'o// de nas gshin don lho sgo'i cho ga ni/ phung po'am gzugs brnyan nam/ ming byang la gzungs sngags bris pa dang bcas pa la/ dmigs yul bskyed cing*/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis dmigs yul de bkug nas bstim/ sum+bha ni brjod cing yungs kar gyis brabs gu gul bdug pas bgegs bskrad/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs tshigs bcad rnams dang*/ las sgrib sbyong ba'i sngags bzla bzhin bum chus bkrus/ sngar nas bsgrub pa'i brabs rdzas kyis brags par bya'o// spros pa la dga' na kun rig gi lho sgor grags pa 'di nyid mdo rgyud sna tshogs las btus ba'i gsang ba spyi chog yin pas sbyar yang rung zhing*/

de nas dbang bskur ba ni rig gtad du grags pa ste/ bum lha nam mkhar btegs pas dbang bskur ba'i bya ba mdzad par bsam la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pas sogs dkyus ltar dang*/ dam rgya spyi bor bzhag pas byin gyis brlabs/ gser sogs kyis bris pa'i gzungs sngags kyi shog dril mgul du btags par bya'o/ de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis shis pa brjod pa ni/ gzungs sngags dang rang rang gi sngags brjod nas bkra shis pa'i rtags rnams slob ma'i mdun du bkod nas mgur nas gsungs pa'i shis pa'i tshigs bcad rnams kyis shis pa brjod pa yin yang*/ bkra shis gang zhig zhes sogs 'di rnams bod rnams kyis rgya gzhung du re ba ltar gyi lugs yin pas grags pa dbang btsan ltar mdzad pa yin 'dug cing bkra shis rdzas rtags kyi rgyu mtshan sogs gzhan du yod pa der blta bar bya'o// de nas rjes kyi bya ba mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog ni cho ga'i dkyus ltar la/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs su thun mthar/ sngags kyi nor bu 'bul ba zhes/ bzlas brjod kyi ni dge ba gang sogs/ bzlas brjod kyi dge ba 'gro ba thams cad byang chub chen po thob pa'i ched du bcom ldan 'das la phul nas phreng ba bris sku sogs kyi mdun du 'jog par gsungs pa bzhin bya'o// sngags dang zla ba sangs rgyas skur sogs/ ye shes pa rang gi lus las phyungs nas de la mchod bstod gshegs gsol bya ba ni rgyud sde 'og ma'i bshad tshod ni yin mod/ bla med kyi nyams len can la de shin tu mi 'thad pas/ bdag bskyed la mchod bstod dang bzod gsol sogs byas nas/ sngags dang zla ba sangs rgyas skur/ rim bzhin bsdus te mi dmigs pa bya zhing*/ mthar rang nyid mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du sogs dgos/ zhes bdag gi bla ma dang rje sgrol mgon zhabs sogs bzhed do// sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni gzhan du gsal zhing*/

mdo 'don pa'i cho ga dang*/ phung po bsregs pa/ mchod par spa ba/ sā ts+tsha'i cho ga sogs ni rje drug pa'i sgrub dkyil du gsal ba ltar ro// de ltar rje gar dbang drug pas stsal ba'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub dkyil rnam bshad nyung ngu 'di ni don gnyer can dag gi don du sngar yi ger bkod yod pa/ karma bstan rgyas kyis bskul ba ltar/ phyis zhu dag dang bcas tshe dbang kun khyab kyis shar dpal spungs dgon du bris pas sems can thams cad rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
